verdict.rationale: Mastra Code's own tools touch parts of a debugging loop. It searches the web for error messages, offers a read-only Explore mode for codebase questions, and returns LSP diagnostics showing errors introduced by an edit, which is a limited form of fix verification. Nothing documents running code or tests to reproduce an issue, or a dedicated workflow for narrowing down root causes. Missing for 10: documented command/test execution to reproduce issues, an explicit root-cause debugging workflow, runtime verification of fixes beyond LSP diagnostics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: Returns Language Server Protocol (LSP) diagnostics showing any errors or warnings introduced by the edit.
Search the web for documentation, error messages, package APIs, and other information.
Switch to Explore mode for read-only codebase questions with minimal latency.
